sourceImageReading.scope: Exact final HTML in an isolated mobile browser; source-image enlargement, scrolling and close/focus restoration.

passed: Independent mathematical, hint, concept and follow-up review for the precise release scope.
Actual Normal and Pearson paper interfaces at desktop/mobile widths: all originals and follow-ups, hints, checked answers, retries, next, final first/after scores and reload.
Local-fixture numbered attempts, account separation, manager read-only presentation, stale iframe rejection and historical edition/concept pinning.
Implemented public-roadmap archive, hide/remove and restore flows preserve answers/history/content.
Public Mock source guards reject purchased Exam Sets and retain source attribution.
Enlarged source questions preserve readable intrinsic dimensions and allow two-axis scrolling while keeping Back to practice reachable.
Build and all listed content, mapping, follow-up, player and regression gates.
unsupported: This release does not supply an authenticated worker that automatically prepares uploaded PDFs.
Permanent deletion of papers, attempts and source files is not implemented; supported public-roadmap hide/remove remains reversible.
unverified: Production logins, credentials, real cloud permissions and cross-device synchronisation were not exercised; account and cloud-runtime checks use isolated local fixtures.
Mobile browser checks use Chromium viewports; native iOS/Android, Safari and Firefox were not exercised.
